fact: The Digital Malawi Acceleration Project, approved June 2024, is appraised at US$150 million with a US$70 million phase 1 grant; its broadband component had actual and committed expenditure of US$9.3m (46.5 percent) of US$20m for phase 1.
title: Digital Malawi Acceleration Project (DMAP, P505095) Implementation Support Mission Aide-Memoire
